Linear Regression

Linear Regression is a useful tool for predicting a quantitative response.

3.1 Simple Linear Regression

Simple linear regression is a straightforward approach for predicting a quantitative response on the basis of a single predictor variable. Mathematically it can be written as:

$$Y \approx \beta_0 + \beta_1 X$$
